NDT software in Salt Lake City: five refineries, a copper mine and a major air base

Few US metros pack as much inspection work into as small an area as the Wasatch Front. Five refineries operate in and just north of Salt Lake City: Chevron and Marathon in Salt Lake City, HF Sinclair and Silver Eagle in Woods Cross, and Big West Oil in North Salt Lake. Much of their crude arrives from the Uinta Basin, including the waxy crude trucked in from eastern Utah. To the southwest, Rio Tinto Kennecott runs the Bingham Canyon Mine, the Magna smelter and its refinery, which means heavy equipment, structural steel, crushers, conveyors and process piping that need regular inspection. North along I-15, the Ogden Air Logistics Complex at Hill Air Force Base maintains military aircraft and missile systems, and rocket motor and composites manufacturers across northern Utah add aerospace NDT demand.

Regulation follows the same patchwork you see elsewhere. The Utah Division of Oil, Gas and Mining covers upstream work in the Uinta Basin. Pipelines fall under PHMSA and state pipeline safety. The Utah Labor Commission's boiler programme covers boilers and pressure vessels. Utah is an Agreement State, so radiography crews are licensed through the Division of Waste Management and Radiation Control.

For a Salt Lake City NDT contractor, the defining feature is overlap. Refinery turnarounds on a short stretch of I-15 can land in the same season, a mine shutdown can arrive at the same time, and aerospace shop work never stops. The Atlantis ERP solution is built to help you run all three without overcommitting.

ERP for NDT companies in Salt Lake City: the short answer

An ERP for NDT companies in Salt Lake City has to stop overcommitment. When several refineries and a mine all want crews at once, you need a live picture of which qualified people and calibrated instruments are really free. The Atlantis ERP puts certifications, calibration, dispatch, reports, procedures and billing in one system, configured by an ASNT NDT Level III.

In Salt Lake City, the cost of a mistake is concentrated. Send an expired technician onto a refinery unit, or a probe with a lapsed calibration certificate, and you risk losing that client in a market where every refinery's contractor coordinators know each other. Double-book a PAUT unit between a Woods Cross turnaround and a Kennecott shutdown, and one of those jobs starts late. The ERP is designed to catch those problems at dispatch rather than on site.

For small NDT companies in Salt Lake City, it also means the owner can bid on turnaround work knowing exactly what capacity is left.

Crew dispatch software for overlapping refinery turnarounds and mine shutdowns

Crew dispatch software is the most valuable part of the ERP for many Salt Lake City contractors, because the refineries sit so close together. In the Team Assignments app, every job moves through planned, dispatched, in field, submitted and closed, with site GPS coordinates and mobilisation and demobilisation dates.

The technician availability calendar shows assigned, leave, training, sick and unavailable days and blocks overlapping bookings. Double-booking a technician is blocked. So is double-booking an instrument by serial number, which matters when you own two PAUT units and three refineries want them. If assigned equipment is out of calibration, the dispatcher is warned. Each technician's current assignment, utilisation percentage and next available date show in calendar, kanban and list views, so you can see before you commit whether the Kennecott job and the North Salt Lake turnaround actually fit.

The Fleet app tracks vehicle purpose, whether a vehicle can carry radioactive sources, its transport licence number and expiry, and its assignment to a project and driver with dates and mileage. Crews heading out to the Uinta Basin or central Utah power plants cover real distance, and the source vehicle's paperwork needs to be current. Time Off feeds availability, so approved leave never gets overlooked during turnaround season.

Technician certification tracking software for Salt Lake City crews

Technician certification tracking in Salt Lake City has to satisfy refinery contractor-qualification teams, mine safety departments and aerospace buyers, each with its own checklist. The Certificates app records scheme (SNT-TC-1A, CP-189, ISO 9712, PCN, CSWIP or other), level, method, certifying body, industry sector, issue, expiry and renewal dates, OJT and training hours, exam results and attachments.

Status is calculated automatically as active, expiring soon (90 days), expired or revoked. Vision tests are tracked separately, with near vision (Jaeger J1/J2), far vision, colour perception, contrast, examiner, clinic and expiry. Examination sheets store general, specific and practical scores against a passing score that defaults to 70%. Certificate templates per scheme set validity in months, vision test and exam requirements, and minimum OJT and training hours.

Daily checks create warning tasks 90 days before expiry, and configurable daily email alerts cover technician certs, calibration certificates and company certifications. Timesheets warn if a technician's certificate is not valid. Each employee NDT profile holds highest level, methods certified, radiation safety training, radiation badge number and medical fitness expiry, which is what refinery and mine site-access teams ask for before badging your crew.

Calibration management software for Salt Lake City instrument fleets

Calibration management software should make it impossible to lose track of a certificate during a busy turnaround season. The Asset Management app tracks every flaw detector, thickness gauge, PAUT and TOFD unit, eddy current instrument, probe and accessory by serial number. Each record holds type, assigned person, condition, asset tag, firmware, accessories and lifecycle status: new, active, in calibration, in repair, rented out, retired or disposed.

Calibration records hold provider, certificate number, standard, range, uncertainty, accredited-lab flag, result and next due date. The certificate register keeps each lab's accreditation number and PDF, with valid, expiring and expired status and expiry alerts. Reservations with clash prevention let you hold a unit for a turnaround weeks in advance. The issue and return workflow, with supervisor and manager approval, records condition both ways, which is useful when gear comes back from a dusty mine site.

The maintenance log records preventive and corrective work, repairs, cleaning, firmware updates and probe replacement, with condition before and after. Consumables including couplant, penetrant, developer, MT particles and PPE carry reorder levels and low-stock flags, with a movement ledger.

NDT reporting software for refinery, mining and aerospace work

NDT reporting software in Salt Lake City has to cover refinery thickness and weld work, mining equipment and aerospace components. The Atlantis ERP includes 17 report types: UT, RT, MT, PT, VT, ECT, IRIS, PAUT, MFL, TOFD, PWHT, PMI, hardness, UT thickness, ferrite, holiday/coating and computed radiography. Each has its own numbering sequence.

At the refineries, UT thickness reports record readings by direction, IRIS and ECT cover exchanger tubes, PMI confirms alloy on piping, and PWHT and hardness reports close out repair welds. RT reports hold source, technique, IQI type and placement, and computed radiography has its own report type. At the mine and smelter, MT and UT on structural members, crusher components and wear-prone weldments are recorded with weld and job lines, including defect type and orientation. On aerospace work, PT, ECT and UT reports carry the method data your customer expects. Every report ends with acceptable, not acceptable or acceptable with remarks.

Reports move from draft through in progress, review and approved to sent, with inspector, reviewer and approver signatures. A third-party or authorised inspector can sign too. References to work order, request, WPS, contract, drawing, procedure and standard are captured on each report. Versioned company templates in Excel, Word, PDF or HTML carry your logo, and Excel templates fill automatically from mapped cells, which suits refineries that want reports in their own format.

The offline field app handles pit-side and remote work without signal. See Digital Twin Reporting Software and the NDT Reports app.

Procedures and written practice for Salt Lake City contractors

With several refineries, a mine and aerospace customers each reviewing your paperwork, procedure control has to be tight. The Procedures app keeps a register with document number, revision, method, scope, material, applicable standard (such as ASME Section V), acceptance criteria and body text or file.

Procedures move from draft through submitted, reviewed and approved to published, with rejection reasons and archiving. Approved revisions lock, and each revision keeps a snapshot, so you can show which revision a crew used on a job last year. The AI-assisted first draft gives your Level III a starting point, and they still review and approve. Approvers get email notifications and reminders.

NDT quoting and invoicing software for Salt Lake City contractors

NDT quoting and invoicing software should turn turnaround and shutdown hours into invoices quickly, before the next job starts. Quotations carry job type, site, project dates and applicable codes, with NDT service products flagged by method and category, a global discount and a branded PDF. Clients can accept and sign online, and the quote converts to a sales order.

Timesheets record inspection, travel, standby and setup as separate work types, along with method, site, client, equipment serial, billable flag, rate multiplier and approval. Turnaround night shifts and standby waiting for permits are recorded as they happen. Invoices carry project, job or PO number, site, invoice type and industry sector, with labour, equipment and consumables subtotals. Lines hold cost centre, method, equipment serial, technician, rate type and days or hours. The financial dashboard shows revenue, cost of sales, gross margin, operating expenses, EBITDA and outstanding invoices over 12 months. Expenses handles per diems and field costs for out-of-town work and re-bills them to the job.

Inspection management software in Salt Lake City: dashboards, CRM and integrations

Inspection management software earns its place when a manager can see trouble coming. NDT KPI dashboards show calibration due and overdue, certs expiring and expired, and issued equipment overdue for return. In the weeks before a turnaround season, that view tells you what to renew and what to chase.

The CRM tracks service line, lead source, NDT service type, industry sector, site country and estimated technicians and days, with an NDT lead score from 0 to 100. Drip email sequences by service line keep refinery, mining and aerospace prospects on separate tracks. The Atlantis ERP has an open REST API and integrates with SAP, Maximo, NetSuite, QuickBooks or any system that accepts API connections. Several large operators on the Wasatch Front run enterprise maintenance systems, and any connection is scoped during implementation.

Affordable, customizable ERP for inspection companies in Salt Lake City: implementation

An affordable, customizable ERP for inspection companies in Salt Lake City is set up around your clients and your written practice. The Atlantis ERP is quoted on request and implemented by Atlantis NDT.

  1. Capacity review. We map your technicians, levels, methods and instruments so dispatch reflects real capacity from day one.
  2. Data import. Certifications, vision tests, calibration certificates, procedures, vehicles and clients are loaded.
  3. Templates. Refinery, mining and aerospace report formats become versioned templates, and quotations get your branding.
  4. Field go-live. Crews start on the offline app on live jobs, ideally before turnaround season rather than during it.
  5. Integrations and training. We scope the API connections and train office staff and Level IIIs.

Atlantis also offers SNT-TC-1A-based Level I, II and III training through the eLearning portal and the Practical NDT 3D simulator. Book a demo configured for a Salt Lake City NDT company.

Frequently asked questions

What is the best NDT software for a Salt Lake City company working refinery turnarounds?

Look for software that shows real crew and instrument capacity and blocks double-booking, alongside certification and calibration tracking. The Atlantis ERP does that in the Team Assignments, Certificates and Asset Management apps, and connects the work to reports and invoices.

Can the ERP stop the same instrument being booked on two jobs?

Yes. Double-booking of equipment serial numbers is blocked in dispatch, and reservations with clash prevention let you hold instruments in advance.

Does it store what refinery and mine site-access teams ask for?

Yes. Each technician's profile holds certifications, vision tests, radiation safety training, radiation badge number and medical fitness expiry, with alerts before anything lapses.

Is the Atlantis ERP affordable for a small Salt Lake City inspection company?

Yes. It is positioned as affordable, accessible and fully customizable, and it is quoted on request based on your size and the apps you need. Ask for a quote.

Which NDT report types are included?

Seventeen: UT, RT, MT, PT, VT, ECT, IRIS, PAUT, MFL, TOFD, PWHT, PMI, hardness, UT thickness, ferrite, holiday/coating and computed radiography.

Can it connect to a client's maintenance system?

Yes. The open REST API supports integrations with SAP, Maximo, NetSuite, QuickBooks or any system that accepts API connections, scoped per implementation.
